decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the core map.apps platform, and the firm's rapid release cycle shows it can absorb feedback, but it no longer appears on the website and may be folded into the platform.
VueTOC was an experimental mobile component that has disappeared from the website since 2018, so its knowledge is better absorbed into the main platform and its resources redeployed.
The flagship platform draws directly on the firm's core GIS engineering knowledge, research and standards work, so it remains central even though it is less visible on the website.
Mobile field data capture lies close to the firm's GIS competence and its public and private customer base, though platform-provider apps raise competitive pressure.

The search extension rests on existing knowledge and costs little to maintain, but the earlier withdrawal of the similar search plugin and its absence from the website raise the risk of consolidation.
